verdict.rationale: A live probe found a real llms.txt served at help.reclaim.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It contains structured, link-indexed help-center content, including a Reclaim 2.0 docs section, that an agent can be pointed at directly. Individual help articles are also served as .md URLs, which are agent-friendly. missing for 10: no first-party documentation announcing or describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs; the root markdown index (/en/.md) returns 404; no machine-readable API spec (all OpenAPI paths 404); no independent or hands-on confirmation of agents using the file; coverage appears limited to the help center rather than product or API docs.
